sentences.japanese: 君はただ人生の問題から逃げているだけだよ。
sentences.english: You're just running away from life's problems.

sentences.japanese: 逃げよう。サツが来てる。
sentences.english: We're getting out of here. The cops are coming.

sentences.japanese: 君はなぜ逃げ出そうとしたのですか。
sentences.english: Why did you try to run away?

sentences.japanese: このチャンスを逃す手はないよ。
sentences.english: You had better avail yourself of this opportunity.

sentences.japanese: 君はここからすぐに逃げたほうがよい。
sentences.english: You had better get away from here at once.
